exclusion_detail: Lead 4a-10 comes from the 11-chloro quindoline intermediates 1a-x and from p-(methylthio)styrene, both stated to be 'prepared following the procedures previously reported' (refs 40-42) with no procedure in this paper; compound 4a-10 itself also has no experimental entry or named side chain in the article text (no SI file available).

lead.label: 4a-10
lead.why: Abstract: 'One of the hits, 4a-10, showed strong stabilizing activity on the G-quadruplex and subsequently repressed NRAS's translation and inhibited tumor cells proliferation.'

notes: Every compound in the paper (series I and II) is made from intermediates 1a-1, 1a-2, 1b-1, 1b-2 prepared per earlier reports, so no compound has an explicit route in this paper. Experimental text covers only the Heck coupling (2a/2b), N-methylation (3a/3b) and the general amination methods.
